scope: The real Notes web application and local Go BFF use synthetic data. Evidence records the exact backend and which scenarios use the local OIDC issuer or fake gRPC Notes service.

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('a second submit does not create a second note'); web/app/App.tsx
evidence.scenario: Submit Create note twice rapidly via dblclick before the first response resolves; app suppresses duplicate POST so only 1 HTTP CreateNote request and 1 saved receipt exist.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via bff-dev --store=grpc (exactly 1 CreateNote RPC emitted on dblclick).

features.title: Sign in, reload, and sign out

evidence.scenario: Drive production //web/app:dist against //bff/cmd/bff and synthetic OIDC issuer: verify pre-auth refusal, PKCE sign-in, private CreateNote, session persistence across tab reload, explicit Sign out, and post-sign-out refusal + reload cleanliness without exposing JWT credentials.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: IMPORTANT #60 BOUNDARY: Production //bff/cmd/bff excludes testonly //bff/testing/grpcstore (#60); OIDC sign-in/reload/sign-out ran against real //bff/cmd/bff (--store=memory) + real OIDC verifier + synthetic issuer.mjs.

features.title: Handle a stopped server and a rendering failure

assertions.stoppedError: The service is unavailable. Try again.
assertions.renderError: The page failed to render. Reload to continue.
assertions.cliStoppedStderr: notes-cli: rpc error [unavailable]: service unreachable: [Errno 61] Connection refused

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('a stopped server is unavailable and a restart is not assumed', "a render error shows the boundary's message, not a blank page"); web/app/ErrorBoundary.tsx
evidence.scenario: Stop the real Go BFF process mid-session and confirm clean unavailable message; independently trigger #planted-render-error to prove React ErrorBoundary shows reload instruction instead of a blank page.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Uses startStack('/') because stopServer() isolates Go BFF SIGTERM independently of fake-notes-grpc (#60); baseline unavailable fault against grpcstore already filmed in Round 1.

assertions.cliMissingRefStderr: notes-cli: rpc error [not_found]: note not found

evidence.exactSource: web/e2e/notes.spec.mjs ('not found', "another principal's note reads as not found"); bff/transport/handlers.go
evidence.scenario: Contrast an unused valid reference (notes/does-not-exist) against another user's private note (bob opening ana's note): both yield identical 'Not found.' without existence leaks.
evidence.grpc60Boundary: Exercised fake-notes-grpc via bff-dev --store=grpc (GetNote + CreateNote + cross-owner GetNote over HTTP/2 application/grpc).
